title: chore: delete nine tinybird endpoints nothing calls
author: ElliotEtag

gist.summary: Removed nine unused Tinybird endpoint pipes: auth_flow_funnel, checkout_outcomes, d1_user_public, kpi_signup_funnel, kpi_tier_distribution, kpi_total_users, model_revenue, product_analytics_daily, and traffic_sources. No underlying data is deleted; the Websites dashboard covers the relevant funnels with its own SQL, and tinybird_read still reads d1_user directly for the Users & Balances and BYOP panels. Updated the Websites dashboard configuration and added a Tinybird deployment prerequisite: deploy from a clean origin/main, match resource changes in the deployment check to merged PRs, and confirm deleted resources have no caller on origin/production before a production deployment.

The main character is a cute pixel art bee mascot with a yellow body and dark brown horizontal stripes, small black legs, two black antennae, black vertical oval eyes, bright pink rectangular blush marks on cheeks, a small happy smile, and small rounded light blue translucent wings; she wears a tiny tool belt and stays small within the scene. Strictly pixel art style, never realistic; cozy pixel art, 8-bit aesthetic, soft pastel gradients, warm lighting, retro gaming vibes.
